fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: Leaps you onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and runs it through, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Biting Scatter
fusions.desc: Nicks everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring-Heeled Tempo
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds and hops you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Every Hop a Lunge
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 5 seconds.
